title: New book from Martinez resident Matt Sieger
author: admin
content: Martinez resident Matt Sieger, whose previous book, The God Squad: The Born-Again San Francisco Giants of 1978 , was published in 2023, has come out with a new book. As with his first book, the publishers of his new volume, In My Humble Opinion: Musings of a Sports Columnist are Eric and Peggy Johnson of Alive Book Publishing in Alamo. Serendipitously, Sieger and the Johnsons attend Creekside Church in Martinez, which is how he hooked up with them to publish his two books. Sieger, now retired, worked as a sportswriter and columnist for The Vacaville Reporter and The Cortland Standard in New York State. He has his B.A. from Cornell University and an M.A. in magazine journalism from Syracuse University’s Newhouse School of Public Communications. The book, which runs 466 pages, is a compilation of sports columns from his newspaper days as well as many from an online outlet called The Sports Column. Also included are interviews with many professional athletes, including Joe DiMaggio, Steve Alford of Indiana University basketball fame, NFL MVP quarterback Brian Sipe, Hall of Fame catcher Gary Carter, former Giants catcher and major league manager Mike Matheny, and legendary 49er tight end Brent Jones. Each column or article runs just two or three pages, so you can just read a few before bed or with your morning coffee and finish the book at a leisurely pace. Among Sieger’s interesting tales are the time he got a hit off Jim Bouton, who pitched in two World Series for the New York Yankees. He also describes the day he covered the Cornell University Cricket Club, and because they were down a man, recruited him to play. Sieger, who played high school and some semi-professional baseball, had never swung a cricket bat in his life. The result is hilarious. He also tells a heartwarming story about a Little League teammate, Lawrence, who, because of his minimum baseball talents, was relegated to right field but became a hero when he helped defeat their team’s arch rival. Sieger also writes about some of the most historic events in sport, including Arthur Ashe’s upset of Jimmy Connors at Wimbledon in 1975, the fight of the century between Muhammed Ali and Joe Frazier, and Bill Buckner’s notorious error for the Red Sox in Game Six against the New York Mets in the 1986 World Series. He also pontificates on who the greatest baseball player is of all time. Willie Mays is on his list, as well as a surprise candidate. Sieger also opines on whether Shohei Ohtani is better than Babe Ruth, whether former Giants shortstop Omar Vizquel belongs in the Hall of Fame, and whether all those recent rule changes in baseball are good for the game. Sieger includes an insider’s look at Barry Bonds from a security guard who had a first-hand view of the slugger’s antics, sports movie and book reviews, and some humorous columns, such as “Ode to a Foul Pole,” “Mascot Names that Need to Go,” and his computer simulation playoff that determined the worst baseball team of all time. The book is available from Amazon and all the major online retailers. The post New book from Martinez resident Matt Sieger appeared first on Martinez News-Gazette .

title: Patrick Owen Sullivan
author: admin
content: Patrick O. Sullivan 1960 – 2026 Patrick Owen Sullivan, 66, passed away from complications of Alport’s Syndrome on August 1, 2026, in Rocklin, CA. Patrick was born in Concord, CA in 1960 to Anthony (Tony) Joseph Sullivan and Janet Hilken Sullivan, who were an Engineer and School Teacher in Martinez, CA. Patrick graduated from the University of California, Berkeley before starting a lengthy career as a technical writer for such companies as 3Com, CISCO, HPE and Workday. He deeply loved and was dedicated to his family and lived in Martinez, Quincy, Concord, New Jersey, Danville, Livermore, and Rocklin. Family vacations were a highlight for Patrick throughout his life. He deeply treasured times away with his family especially in nature. In his early years, he spent vast amounts of time in the Sierras, including living and vacationing in Quincy, CA, annual trips to Arnold, CA, and skiing every winter in Tahoe. As an adult, he continued his love of nature by regularly taking his own family to Arnold (Lakemont Pines) and Mendocino to enjoy time together in California’s natural beauty. Patrick was an avid tennis player in high school and enjoyed the game with family and friends after graduating. Sports and family continued to be an important part of his life, whether it was watching Chandler play football, Aidan on the golf course, or Reghan on the volleyball court. One of Patrick’s most endearing qualities was also his humor. He often amused everyone at extended family gatherings by his dry wit and satirical commentary, which was even more entertaining than watching a comedy. Patrick was preceded in death by his parents, Anthony (Tony) Sullivan, Janet Hilken Sullivan, and his sister, Nora Nelson (Scott Nelson), and is survived by his wife, Shannon Sullivan, his children Chandler, Aidan, and Reghan; his brother, Neil Sullivan and sister-in-law, Tracey Sullivan. We will miss him very much. A Celebration of Life Service will be held on October 16, 2026, at Old St. Mary’s Chapel, 5251 Front Street, Rocklin CA at 4:00pm. Donations in Patrick’s memory can be made to the Alport’s Syndrome Foundation ( https://alportsyndrome.org/ ) The post Patrick Owen Sullivan appeared first on Martinez News-Gazette .

title: Martinez Girl Named Youth of the Year
author: admin
content: Elizabeth, who everyone calls Elly, has been a member of the Boys & Girls Club of Contra Costa for two years. In that time she has grown into a young person who leads with confidence, creativity and kindness. This year she became our first Junior Youth of the Year candidate and went on to win the title for the entire Boys & Girls Clubs of Silicon Valley. Before joining the Club, Elly spent her afternoons at the community pool learning to swim and spending time with friends. When she arrived at the Club she found something different. She found a place that encouraged her to explore her interests, try new things and meet people outside her usual circle. She says the Club helped her become more outgoing and more open to getting to know others. One of the first places she stepped into leadership was the Karaoke Club. Elly did not just join it. She created it. As President she built a space where members could sing, dance and enjoy themselves without fear of judgment. At school she sometimes feels unsafe or judged for the things she enjoys. At the Club she feels safe. She calls it her home away from home. Her leadership also connects to a tradition at the Martinez Clubhouse. Every Friday, members help create and run mini clubs based on their passions. These Friday mini clubs give young people a chance to share what they love and invite others to join in. Elly’s Karaoke Club grew out of this spirit and quickly became one of the most popular Friday activities. Her confidence continued to grow when she joined a small community garden project that became something much bigger for the city of Martinez. Alongside her peers and volunteers from the New Leaf Collaborative, she helped build a shared garden where families can pick fresh fruits and vegetables. She planted seeds, replaced soil, watered beds, pulled weeds and helped paint signs that now welcome visitors. The garden project also sparked something new at the Club. Members were so inspired by the experience that they created a Garden Club, where they continue to learn and work together. With their help, part of the area in front of the clubhouse has now been converted into a native pollinator garden. It is a space filled with plants that support butterflies and bees, and the kids enjoy tending to it and watching it grow. Soon after, Elly stepped into the arts. After performing in Oliver Jr she began attending more art lessons and helped launch Drama Matters. Drama Matters is part of the core curriculum in our arts program, and Elly quickly became one of the members who helped bring it to life. With her experience she was asked to help teach her peers the full process of putting on a production. She has helped guide rehearsals, organize responsibilities and build a program that will continue long after she moves on. Through all of these experiences Elly has discovered her voice and her ability to lead. She says it best in her own words: “Without the Boys & Girls Club, I believe I would not have been given so many wonderful opportunities to lead, experience and inspire the community created by our clubhouse. I hope to see my peers gain the same qualities that I have received. Grabbing onto the many possibilities that will allow them to begin their great future, because I believe it all starts here.” The post Martinez Girl Named Youth of the Year appeared first on Martinez News-Gazette .

title: Pete Emmons and Small Town With a Big Heart
author: admin
content: submitted by Colleen Gianatiempo Hi. My friend Pete Emmons worked on the “Small Town with a Big Heart Mural” from 2016-2017 in the creek area near Starbucks downtown. He just passed away and I wanted to let everyone know in Martinez! When I met Pete Emmons in 2016, I didn’t first know him as a legendary figure in the drum corps world or as one of the longtime leaders behind the Blue Devils organization. I met him while painting a downtown Martinez mural called Small Town With a Big Heart. The title now feels especially fitting. The very first day Pete volunteered on the mural, I showed up a few minutes late. He stood there wearing his Ray-Ban sunglasses, looked at me, and dramatically tapped his watch as if to say, “You’re late.” It instantly made me laugh. That was Pete — funny, sharp, observant, and somehow able to make an impression in seconds. What started as a volunteer connection slowly became a friendship, and over time Pete became like family to me. He showed up constantly in my life in ways that mattered. He attended my son’s gymnastics meets, helped me with art shows, and supported my creative work with genuine enthusiasm. In many ways, he became a father figure and steady presence in my life. Many people knew Pete as a respected leader, mentor, and Hall of Fame figure in the marching arts community through his decades with the Blue Devils Drum and Bugle Corps. He helped shape generations of performers and was part of one of the most successful organizations in drum corps history. But what always stood out to me most was his humility. Despite all he had accomplished, he showed up to help paint a community mural. No ego. No need for recognition. Just a willingness to serve, connect, and contribute. Pete understood something important: community matters, whether on a football field, backstage at a performance, or standing on a downtown sidewalk with a paintbrush in hand. His passing leaves a tremendous hole for so many people whose lives he touched quietly and consistently. I feel incredibly fortunate that I got to know not just the public figure, but the man behind the sunglasses and the playful watch tap. Every time I see that mural, I’ll think of Pete Emmons — not only as a legend in the drum corps world, but as part of the heart behind Martinez itself. title: Beaver Festival Better than Ever
author: admin
content: Where else can you see a giant beaver skull, a 1,500-gallon aquarium on wheels, an 18-piece jazz band, a children’s parade, live displays of raptors, owls, and bats, and an award-winning chalk artist, all while learning the firsthand story of the rodent that made one forgotten city famous? Only one place: the Martinez Beaver Festival. Returning for its 17th year, the festival offers free family fun where you can learn all about beavers, citizen science, urban wildlife, community involvement, and how to combat drought, fires, and global warming—one beaver at a time. There are many more beaver festivals now around the country, and many more books and films to explain why beavers matter, but this is the one that inspired them all. Come see for yourself why beavers are Worth A Dam. Where: Susana Park (Martinez, Estudillo and Susana Streets) When: June 13th, 2026, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Cost: FREE Hosted by: Worth A Dam (www.martinezbeavers.org) The post Beaver Festival Better than Ever appeared first on Martinez News-Gazette .

title: Geraldine (Geri) Keary
author: admin
content: Geraldine (Geri) Keary Long-time Martinez resident Geraldine (Geri) Keary, born on February 22, 1935 in Utah she was a profoundly gifted artist and cherished mother, passed away peacefully on May 13, 2026 at the age of 91. She leaves behind a rich legacy written in color, texture, and the countless lives she touched through her art and creative spirit. Over the course of her distinguished career, Geri’s paintings were featured in numerous shows and exhibitions. She had earned her national Signature Awards from the American Watercolor Society (AWS), National Watercolor Society (NWS), California Watercolor Association (CWA) and the International Society of Marine Painters (ISMP) by entering and being accepted into their national juried shows. Beyond the studio, Geri loved the ocean, fishing, camping with the family and boating with her husband Bob and friends. Geri is survived by her devoted family, including her children Judy, Ken and Michele, 7 grandchildren and 5 great-grandchildren. She was predeceased by her husband and partner-in-crime of 69 years, Robert Keary. Geri will be interred at the Sacramento Valley National Cemetery. In memory of Geri, the family suggests making a contribution to a charitable cause of your choice that supports the arts. The post Geraldine (Geri) Keary appeared first on Martinez News-Gazette .

title: The Heartwarming Holiday Move Kristen Bell Did That Made Dax Shepard Propose THE SAME NIGHT!
author: Perez Hilton
content: Kristen Bell did something SO sweet, SO touching that it completely melted Dax Shepard ‘s mind and heart. On the new episode of his Armchair Expert podcast, Kristen and Dax describe how their impromptu proposal went down on the Christmas Eve of 2009. Joined by her Nobody Wants This co-stars, Kristen tells Adam Brody , Justine Lupine , and Timothy Simons the romantic holiday story, and how it was especially meaningful since Dax had been a big ol’ Grinch when it came to the idea of marriage. Related: Blind Item, A Christmas To Remember Read below to see how it went down all those moons ago! Dax: But I had planned the thing. There was a restaurant that we went to one time was the first time I said ‘I love you’ to you. Kristen: [It was] Stanley’s in the valley. Dax: And I think roughly it was going to be around some kind of anniversary. I don’t know why I was months out with it cuz I had the ring forever. Kristen: You did?! Dax: Yeah. Kristen: I had surrendered [to the idea Dax was never going to propose]. Because you told me you didn’t believe in marriage. Pageantry. I was like, I kind of like that tradition. And he said because a piece of paper filed at a courthouse somewhere in California is not going to dictate the how I treat you. It’s just not. And so I’m going to treat you well and act like your partner for the rest of your life. but it has nothing to do with that piece of paper. So, these are very different things we’re talking about. And I was like, well, that’s kind of a pretty decent point. Dax: There was some anarchist point of view is like, I don’t have to ask the state of California if we can be together and then ask them if we cannot be together. If I can treat you like my wife, we’re both children of like multiple divorces between the two of us. We got like eight divorces between the two of us. I was like, what does this mean? This thing doesn’t mean anything. Kristen: So, I was like, okay, well, he treats me like his wife. Like I guess who cares. And then it was Christmas Eve. Eve. Yeah. And I [had flown] back from Detroit. I’d flown to Detroit by myself. Picked up his parents and flown back to California with them. And so we had been on a plane. It was a really fast trip. I was exhausted. We got in bed and… Dax: What happened for me was we had had this beautiful Christmas Eve with my family and um we were in bed that night and you were kind of expressing gratitude for this little family we were making and I was like, ‘Oh, this is the moment I’m going to try to recreate in a month at Stanley’s over a salad, but it’s happening.’ I was like, ‘F**k it. I’m just going to go get the ring now.’ And then I went into the closet. I had it in a jacket pocket. Kristen: He was rustling in the closet sand somehow I sensed it immediately. I’m like there’s nothing else he could be doing with this amount of priority right now that would seem this important. And so I just knew and so like my spine started tingling and like I just started like breathing heavy and he came out. Dax: Yeah. She’s already crying by the time I got back to the bed. Kristen: And he got down on one knee and he said, ‘Will you marry me?’ And then I started sobbing really really hard because that was very overwhelming of something I didn’t think was coming. Yeah. For about maybe I don’t know 45 minutes. We fall asleep. Next morning I get up to go make coffee and his mom comes to me in the kitchen and she goes, ‘Are you okay, bubby? I heard you crying last night. Did you guys have a fight?’ And I was like, [shows the ring] ‘no, I’m engaged!'” Aww!! So at some point Dax’s heart had already warmed to the idea of marriage since he was planning on proposing months later, but it was Kristen’s total wifey move of bringing his family in town for Christmas that made him feel like he couldn’t wait any longer. Pretty epic proposal story! content: Natalie Portman is beaming with new life, literally! The actress just had her third child at 45 , and she’s fully reveling in the magic of it all. title: Meghan Markle Confronted Dad Thomas Over Child Abuse Allegations In Final Letter -- And Told Him THIS
author: Perez Hilton
content: [Warning: Potentially Triggering Content] Meghan Markle reportedly made one thing VERY clear to her estranged father in the last letter she ever sent him: he would NEVER meet her children. According to a Saturday report from The Sun , the Duchess of Sussex, 45, sent her estranged father Thomas Markle Sr., 82, a letter in December of last year while he was hospitalized in the Philippines following a leg amputation caused by a blood clot. But this message wasn’t an attempt at reconciliation. Far from it, in fact. Related: Meghan & Harry’s ‘Too Awkward And Too Difficult’ Christmas Plans Revealed… The outlet reports that Meghan confronted her father over allegations he had sexually abused children , telling him she knew about the accusations and that authorities were aware of his alleged behavior. She reportedly informed him that he would never meet the two children she shares with Prince Harry — 7-year-old Prince Archie and 5-year-old Princess Lilibet — and that he would never hear from her again. And Meghan apparently wanted proof that her message had been received . According to The Sun , she arranged for hospital management to personally deliver the letter to Thomas’ bedside, obtain his signature acknowledging receipt, and record him accepting it. Whoa… The revelation comes amid disturbing allegations that Thomas possessed child sexual abuse material at his former home in Cebu, Philippines. As we previously reported, Meghan’s half-brother Thomas Markle Jr. allegedly discovered four large boxes containing hundreds, potentially thousands, of illicit images, along with videos involving underage girls. He reported his discovery to authorities in July, including the FBI and child protection officials. Thomas Jr. told The Sun earlier this week: “What I saw made me sick to the stomach — all this stuff was just dumped on me, and I didn’t know what to do. I knew right away it was highly illegal and would land me in jail for a long time if I didn’t get rid of it. I felt betrayed, angry and disgusted — and realized I had to report him.” Thomas Sr. has vehemently denied the allegations, calling them lies in a statement to the Daily Mail on Friday. Meanwhile, Meghan revealed in a statement to People on Saturday that she had been made aware of troubling accusations against her father years earlier, after a letter containing allegations was sent to London’s Metropolitan Police . She explained: “That letter was subsequently shared with me. It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father, and I was given assurances that these were being investigated.” The Metropolitan Police have since confirmed receiving the letter in January 2019 and passing it to Meghan’s office, but acknowledged that the allegations were never shared with other law enforcement agencies. The department is now reviewing its handling of the matter and considering whether to refer itself to Britain’s police watchdog. Related: Harry Admits His & Meghan’s ‘Attitudes Have Changed’ — And Opens Up About Family Rift Meghan’s representative attributed the discrepancy between her recollection of the 2018 timeline and police records from 2019 to the passage of time. And as questions continue to swirl about what authorities knew and when, Meghan has offered an explanation for her years-long estrangement from her father: “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children, was for one reason: to protect them.” The FBI has also confirmed it is aware of the allegations and will assist Philippine authorities as appropriate while examining any potential violations of U.S. law. The allegations against Thomas remain unproven, of course. But Meghan’s reported final letter makes clear just how firmly she had already decided to close the door on their relationship. title: Mom Allegedly Abducted Her Three Young Children During Family Visit -- Now All Four Are Missing
author: Perez Hilton
content: [Warning: Potentially Triggering Content] This is such a frightening situation. Police in Toronto are searching for a 22-year-old mother who allegedly abducted her three young children during a family visit on Friday. Now, all four are missing. According to People and other news outlets on Saturday morning, Somerda Miclescu (pictured above) allegedly took off with her son Daniel , 6, and daughters Irina , 3, and Anastasia , just 4 months old, during a semi-supervised visit back on Friday afternoon. Authorities say she does not have legal custody of the children. Related: ‘Today Show’ Break-In ‘Incredibly Triggering’ For Savannah Guthrie After Mom’s Abduction The Toronto Police Service explained as much in a statement sent out to multiple media outlets on Saturday morning: “At approximately 11:32 a.m., police responded to a call for an Abduction in the Midland Avenue and Eglinton Avenue East area. The children were visiting a family member, and the accused took the children and fled the premises.” Miclescu is now wanted for “abduction by parent.” Investigators believe she may be driving a white 2017 Ford Expedition with Ontario license plate DJJS 875 . Police describe her as 5-foot-7 and approximately 180 pounds, with long black hair. She was last seen wearing a dark-colored top and a long black skirt. Later on Saturday morning, a TPS spokesperson told the mag: “I can confirm that this is still an active and ongoing investigation. There are officers assigned to this case currently, and investigators are following up on any leads and canvassing for any witnesses or video.” Regarding the possibility of an Amber Alert , the spokesperson added: “If this goes to an Amber Alert, which would be determined by the investigators, they will go through the proper channels via the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP).” The circumstances surrounding Miclescu’s custody situation remain unclear, and police have not publicly disclosed further details about that yet. Related: FBI Reveals Sad Update In Abduction Of Savannah Guthrie’s Mother Anyone with information about the family’s whereabouts is urged to contact Toronto Police at 416-808-4100. Such a heartbreaking ordeal. We’re hoping these three little children are found safe and sound — and soon. title: Jay-Z Picks Himself to Headline 2027 Super Bowl Halftime Show
author: Justin Harp
content: Jay-Z will headline the 2027 Super Bowl halftime show. “From Reasonable Doubt to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey,” Jay-Z, 56, said in a statement. “Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world’s biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true.” Jay-Z’s entertainment company, Roc Nation, has curated and produced every Super Bowl halftime performance since striking a deal with the NFL in 2019, so the billionaire rapper,essentially picked himself to take the stage during the league’s next championship game on February 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, on ABC. NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said the timing was right for Jay-Z to take to the stage considering the “extraordinary impact he has had on the Super Bowl Halftime Show” over the past seven years. Super Bowl Halftime Performers Through the Years “When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that Jay-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him,” Goodell, 67, added. “I couldn’t be more excited for fans around the world to experience the artistry, creativity and cultural impact he will bring to the Super Bowl stage.” Oliver Schusser , Apple’s Vice President of Music and International Content, said in a statement, “Jay-Z’s impact on global music culture is as profound as it is undeniable. We’ve had the privilege of working closely with him these last few years to bring some of the world’s most exciting and prolific artists to the Super Bowl Halftime Show stage and we are so thrilled that he will be taking that stage himself this year. We know it’s going to be an incredible show.” Jay-Z is currently in the midst of a massive musical comeback. While has not released an album since 2017’s 4:44 , the 25-time Grammy winner performed three sold-out shows at Yankee Stadium in the Bronx in July to celebrate the 30th and 25th anniversaries of his classic records Reasonable Doubt and The Blueprint , respectively. He then headlined shows in London and Paris, where he sang “Happy Birthday” to his wife, Beyoncé , a two-time Super Bowl performer herself. Jay-Z also sat down with music producer Rick Rubin for a retrospective HBO docuseries, Jay-Z in 8 , which premiered in September. Next, he is scheduled to do two concerts at SoFi Stadium — notably the 2027 Super Bowl venue — on Friday, October 23, and Saturday, October 24. Super Bowl LXI will mark the first time that the championship game has ever been played on Valentine’s Day as well as the second time it has taken place at SoFi Stadium. (Super Bowl LVI was held at the Los Angeles-area venue on February 13, 2022, when the L.A. Rams beat the Cincinnati Bengals 23-20.) “We are thrilled to return to the world-class SoFi Stadium for Super Bowl LXI, five years after the Los Angeles Rams lifted the Lombardi Trophy on their home field,” NFL commissioner Roger Goodell announced on February 9. “L.A. is our backyard — two franchises, NFL Network, incredible media partners and in 2028, flag football in the Summer Olympics. We have the utmost confidence in the Los Angeles Super Bowl Host Committee to put on another great show.” The halftime show for the 2026 Super Bowl — which saw the Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 29-13 — proved to be highly controversial due to the league’s selection of Bad Bunny as its lead performer. (His set featured cameos from Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin .) Conservatives, including President Donald Trump , called for boycotts of the halftime show since much of Bad Bunny’s music is performed in Spanish. Boxer Jake Paul , meanwhile, was widely criticized for describing Bad Bunny as a “fake American” even though the Puerto Rican artist is a U.S. citizen by birth. Beyonce and Jay-Z’s Rare Family Photos With Blue Ivy, Rumi and Sir Bad Bunny (real name Benito Ocasio) made light of the backlash at a February press conference as he joked that viewers “[wouldn’t] even have to learn Spanish” to enjoy his performance. “It’s better they learn to dance,” he insisted. “There’s no better dance than the one that comes from the heart. That’s the only thing that they need to worry about.” The late conservative activist Charlie Kirk ’s advocacy group, Turning Point USA, infamously held a competing concert — called the All-American Halftime Show — in Atlanta to counter Bad Bunny’s set. (Charlie was fatally shot at age 31 at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah, in September 2025. His alleged killer, Tyler Robinson , has pleaded not guilty.) “It’s powerful because what Charlie always loved and knew is that he wanted to be in the forefront of the culture war,” Charlie’s widow, Erika Kirk , told Fox News in February. “He would be fist-pumping at this. He would be so stoked. And what better way to honor him than to just get in the middle of this and be able to offer an alternative to families.” Turning Point USA's All-American Halftime Show Controversy Explained The All-American Halftime Show featured music from Kid Rock , Brantley Gilbert , Gabby Barrett and Lee Brice as well as a tribute to Charlie. Early viewing figures suggested that the All-American Halftime Show brought in 19 million viewers in its first 24 hours on YouTube while the NFL touted more than 4 billion views for its halftime show across multiple platforms for the same amount of time. Nevertheless, TPUSA spokesperson Andrew Kolvet described the All-American Halftime Show as a “massive success” as he confirmed plans for a second show in 2027 . “So I can tell you, that’s a shot across the bow,” he said on Fox News’ One Nation With Brian Kilmeade on February 8. “People are paying attention. And if you give us a year to plan this thing, I’m really excited to see what we can pull off.”

title: Meghan Markle, Harry Leave U.K. to Visit Friends Amid Her Dad Thomas' Scandal
author: Johnni Macke
content: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have reportedly left the U.K. to stay with a friend amid allegations that her estranged father, Thomas Markle Sr. , was in possession of photographic material depicting child sex abuse. The Duke and Duchess of Sussex have taken a trip overseas with their two children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet , and are spending time with close friends, Hello! reported on Monday, October 26. “She’s just really, really upset,” Meghan’s unnamed friends told the outlet, referring to the stress associated with Thomas’ latest scandal. “She keeps on looking at Lili and she’s in tears, and thinking about all the children, the alleged victims. She has young children herself. It’s just devastating.” News broke on Thursday, October 22, that Meghan’s estranged father, 82, is under investigation by local authorities after his son, Thomas Markle Jr. , claimed to have discovered a cache of child sex abuse material (CSAM) allegedly in boxes at Thomas Sr.’s house in the Philippines, where he lived until early 2025. UK Police Address Investigation Into Meghan Markle's Estranged Dad Thomas According to Hello!, Meghan, 45, “decided a while ago, before this happened, that she was going to take herself away from the media and not look at anything, for her own mental health.” The former actress’ friend told the outlet on Monday, that the allegations against Thomas Sr. have made it nearly impossible to block out the noise. “She’s been getting sent a lot of messages from friends in the U.K. and people all over saying how sorry they are, but it’s just been an emotional rollercoaster for her,” Meghan’s pal said. “She’s in bits.” Us has reached out to Meghan’s rep for comment. Police Confirm Meghan Markle Received Letter Accusing Dad of Abuse Meghan has been estranged from her father for several years, beginning in May 2018 ahead of her and Harry’s high-profile U.K. nuptials. At the time, Thomas Sr. was accused of posing for staged paparazzi photos in an attempt to benefit from his daughter’s newfound international fame and did not attend their wedding. Thomas Sr., who shares Meghan with ex-wife Doria Ragland , has never met the couple’s son, Archie, 7, or daughter Lilibet, 5. (Thomas Sr. also shares son Thomas Jr., 60, and daughter Samantha Markle with his first wife, Rosyln Loveless .) Despite distancing herself from her father, Meghan’s family made headlines last week after Thomas Jr. claimed he was “horrified” to discover child sex abuse material at his dad’s home, where he served as a caregiver for Thomas Sr. following his stroke in 2022. Thomas Markle Sr. Courtesy YouTube/60 Minutes Australia “I had no option but to report my dad,” Thomas Jr. told The Sun on Thursday. “I have supported, cared for him and helped him for years — but that stops now. I won’t speak to my father ever again unless I’m called to give evidence against him.” Thomas Sr., who currently resides at a nursing home in Florida, denied the allegations . “I’m shocked, I’m hurt and I’m very upset that my son is making these accusations against me,” he told the Daily Mail on Friday, October 23. “I could never do what I’m being accused of. It’s the worst thing anyone could accuse me of. This is bulls***. It’s just a bunch of lies. It’s sick. I have no idea why Tom is trying to destroy me with these lies.” Meghan broke her silence that same day, saying in a statement shared with Us , “I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed.” Prince Harry's Past Remarks on Thomas Markle Resurface Amid Investigation “In 2018, a letter was sent to the Metropolitan Police and Royalty and Specialist Protection. That letter was subsequently shared with me,” she explained. “It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated.” The Suits alum continued, “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children, was for one reason: to protect them. I trusted that the authorities were doing the same for other families.” Meghan concluded, “Although the breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine, my sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children.” Thomas Markle Accused of Sexual Abuse in 2018 Letter to Police: Report Multiple outlets later reported that Meghan sent Thomas Sr. a letter in 2025 while he was hospitalized revealing that she knew about the allegations against him. She allegedly wrote in the letter that her father would never be allowed to meet her children and she wouldn’t contact him any further. Thomas Sr. denied ever receiving a letter from Meghan, telling The Sun on Saturday, October 24, “[Meghan] never said a word to me about this letter accusing me of such terrible things. If Meghan or anyone else had come to me in 2018 and told me about the letter, I would have had a chance to defend myself.” He also refuted the allegations that he sexually assaulted a child. “I have never had sex with anyone under the age of 18,” Thomas Sr. told the outlet, vowing to “do whatever it takes” to clear his name. If you or someone you know is experiencing child abuse, call or text Child Help Hotline at 1-800-422-4453.

title: Taylor Swift Makes Music History at Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame
author: Justin Harp
content: Taylor Swift is once again staking her place in music history with her induction into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame. The “Patient Zero” singer, 36, officially became the youngest inductee in the prestigious music organization during its annual ceremony at Music City Center in Nashville on Monday, October 26. She wore a stunning burgundy velvet crystal embellished mini dress with chiffon print from designer Raisa Vanessa ‘s winter 2026 collection. ( Matraca Berg — who wrote hits for Trisha Yearwood and Kenny Chesney — was previously the youngest inductee in the Hall of Fame when she was selected at age 44 in 2008.) Lainey Wilson performed a cover of “Love Story” while country music legend Brad Paisley inducted the singer-songwriter. Swift later shared a hilarious anecdote from opening for Paisley, 53, on his Bonfires & Amplifiers Tour in 2007. “We’ve been estranged since 2007,” Swift joked . “He took a tour prank too far, filled my entire tour bus with live crickets, thousands of them. For months I couldn’t sleep. All night I considered buying a pet lizard to eradicate the problem.” Taylor Swift Through the Years: From Nashville Upstart to Music Superstar Swift said she knew from an early age that songwriting would be her “passion,” even if it didn’t become her career. “[Songwriting] would be what I centered my entire life around,” she told attendees. “Nashville is the place that I went to in my middle school daydreams. It was the place where all the wisdom that I wished to acquire existed in one place. All the lessons that I wished to learn existed in this magical place for me. And it ended up being all of that and more. It ended up being everything.” The musician assured Hall of Fame voters that it was “not lost on [her] how crazy this is” to be joining their ranks. “I will cherish it forever because Nashville is the place that honed and polished the thing about myself and the thing about my life that I am the most proud of and the most passionate about,” Swift concluded. “So to be here with you and to be getting to have this moment, I am truly grateful and it just feels like one of those amazing Nashville moments I’m going to revisit on a rainy day.” Swift is being honored by this year’s Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame alongside Shawn Camp , Bruce Channel , Lyle Lovett and Lee Thomas Miller . Emmylou Harris , Johnny Cash , Garth Brooks and Dolly Parton are among the most notable and beloved inductees from previous years. Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame executive director Mark Ford read a statement penned by Swift during a livestream in August after announcing her induction. “From the time I started writing songs as a child, I fixated on Nashville as the perfect place to be,” the pop star’s statement read. “I wanted to learn with and from the best and get to immerse myself in a community of storytellers, and thankfully Nashville turned out to be exactly what I’d dreamed of.” The 14-time Grammy winner hailed Nashville as “a town that validated and prioritized hard work, determination and imagination.” “[Nashville is where] the writers show up to work every day even when the mysterious muses and the magic don’t,” she added. “To be honored by this city I love so much is a beautiful thing, and I’m very grateful.” It has been a milestone year in Swift’s career, as she previously became the youngest female honoree at the 2026 Songwriters Hall of Fame at a ceremony in New York City in June. During her acceptance speech, Swift acknowledged the important role her family played in supporting her early Nashville career. Taylor Swift attends the Songwriters Hall of Fame 55th Annual Induction and Awards Gala. Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images “It was easy to choose songwriting over everything else in my life, but it couldn’t have been easy for my parents and my brother to just pick up and move our entire family from Pennsylvania to relocate to Nashville so that I could hone my craft in the songwriting capital of the world,” she told a star-studded audience. “But after making obvious that this was not even remotely a temporary phase their teen daughter was going through, they uprooted their entire lives to move me to Music City. And even though words are supposed to kind of be my thing, I will never be able to express my gratitude to you guys for doing that for me. You’re the reason I’m here tonight.” The career accolades continued in September when Swift’s longtime friend Dakota Johnson presented her with the first-ever MTV VMA Artist Director Honors at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, in recognition of the cultural impact of her music videos. “I’ve gotten to be a part of making 60 music videos, roughly … 18 of those I wrote and directed, and I really love writing and directing music. I got to tell you, though, the main reason why I love writing and directing music videos so much is because you, the fans, make it so much fun. You make it so rewarding because you actually care about what we’re making.” Taylor Swift Stuns in Floral at Songwriters Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony She continued, “So, you know, I want to say thank you to everyone who ever worked on a music video that I got to be a part of. I learned something from every single person that ever worked alongside me on these projects. Mainly, I want to say thank you to the fans.” On top of receiving multiple industry awards, Swift’s dedicated fans celebrated the 20th anniversary of her 2006 self-titled debut album on Sunday, October 24.

title: Donald Trump Accused of Rape in Report Linking President to Jeffrey Epstein
author: Justin Harp
content: President Donald Trump is being accused of historic rape allegations by a former beauty queen as part of a House Judiciary Committee report on the former reality TV star’s alleged ties to the late convicted sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein . Rep. Jamie Raskin , the ranking Democratic member of the House Judiciary Committee, released a shocking report on Monday, October 26, that alleges that Trump, 80, was a “co-conspirator” in “Jeffrey Epstein’s conspiracy to traffic and abuse young women in the 1990s,” in addition to being accused by more than 25 women of sexual impropriety throughout his lifetime. The president has denied ever committing sexual assault. Trump has previously claimed he ended his friendship with Epstein and kicked him out of his Palm Beach resort Mar-A-Lago over allegations the disgraced billionaire “stole” his employees — long before Epstein was convicted of procuring a person under 18 for prostitution and soliciting prostitution in 2008. Committee staffers spoke with former Swiss beauty queen Beatrice Keul, who previously alleged in a 2024 Daily Mail interview that Trump groped her during an encounter at New York City’s Plaza Hotel in November 1993. The Women Who’ve Accused Donald Trump of Sexual Misconduct Keul, 55, subsequently told the House committee that she met Trump at the Plaza Hotel in connection with the American Dream Pageant. Once Trump stepped away from their conversation, Epstein — who died by suicide in 2019 after being arrested on fresh sex trafficking charges — allegedly introduced himself to Keul as “Don’s best friend” and offered to arrange her travel to Mar-A-Lago. The former model further alleges that Trump later raped her in his hotel room, promising to help her arrange a visa and secure her enrollment New York University if she did not go public about the alleged encounter. He later allegedly reiterated his promise when he called her in Switzerland sometime later. “Upon entering [his hotel room], Trump reportedly grabbed Keul from behind and forcibly raped her; in the process, tearing her dress and causing bleeding and bruising on multiple parts of her body,” the Judiciary Committee report read. “Keul described the rape as ‘brutal.'” The House report contains direct testimony from four other women who “accused Trump of rape or sexual assault in Epstein’s company or presence.” “None of these allegations are true. This ‘report’ is nothing more than a desperate attempt by crazed Democrats to distract Americans from the surging Republican momentum driven by President Trump’s historic achievements,” White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis told Us on Monday and as the White House remains without a press secretary . “The President kicked Jeffrey Epstein out of his club at Mar-a-Lago because he was a creep, and he has been fully exonerated of anything related to Epstein.” U.S. President Donald Trump Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images Following the publication of the House Judiciary Committee report on Monday, Rep. Raskin, 63, called for the appointment of an independent special counsel to investigate Trump’s alleged ties to Epstein in greater detail. “Donald Trump says he knew Jeffrey Epstein ‘just like everybody in Palm Beach knew him.’ Not exactly. Evidence involving 11 women tells a completely different and far more damning story about their relationship and the abuse of young women and girls that took place in their network,” Rep. Raskin said in a statement. “Five women have directly accused Trump of rape or sexual assault in Epstein’s company or presence; others have indicated that Epstein or [his accomplice Ghislaine ] Maxwell attempted to traffic them to Trump.” Rep. Raskin alleged that although multiple witnesses and alleged victims have “spoken to investigators and, in some cases, testified under oath,” Trump’s Justice Department has allegedly “shut down investigations, deliberately withheld evidence and, through [Attorney General] Todd Blanche , prevented Ghislaine Maxwell from discussing a survivor whose account implicated Trump — all while insisting there is no basis upon which to investigate Epstein’s possible accomplices.” “Trump’s Justice Department appears to be covering up these crimes to protect the President,” the committee’s ranking Democrat continued. “The women who survived Epstein deserve to be heard, Congress must have the complete files required by law, and an independent special counsel must investigate Epstein’s co-conspirators and DOJ’s cover-up and ensure that state and foreign prosecutors have the evidence they need to pursue justice.” In addition to his alleged ties to Epstein, Trump has been accused of sexual impropriety by more than two dozen women. Writer E. Jean Carroll successfully sued Trump amid accusations of defamation and sexual assault over an alleged incident that occurred in the 1990s in a Bergdorf Goodman department store. Carroll, 82, was awarded $5 million and $83.3 million in damages in two respective judgments. (The Supreme Court denied Trump’s request for the high court to review his appeal of the $5 million judgment in August.) The 1993 book Lost Tycoon: The Many Lives of Donald Trump included allegations that the mogul committed a “violent assault” against his ex-wife Ivana Trump during their marriage. (Trump called the accusations “obviously false” at the time.) “[O]n one occasion during 1989, Mr. Trump and I had marital relations in which he behaved very differently toward me than he had during our marriage,” Ivana later said in a statement. “As a woman, I felt violated, as the love and tenderness, which he normally exhibited towards me, was absent. I referred to this as a ‘rape,’ but I do not want my words to be interpreted in a literal or criminal sense.” Ivana was granted a divorce from Donald in December 1990 on the grounds of “cruel and inhumane” conduct because of his affair with eventual second wife Marla Maples . (Donald and Maples, 62, were married from 1993 to 1999 and he later wed Melania Trump in 2005. Ivana died at age 73 in 2022.) If you or someone you know has been sexually assaulted, contact the National Sexual Assault Hotline at 1-800-656-HOPE (4673). If you or someone you know is a human trafficking victim, contact the National Human Trafficking Hotline at 1-888-373-7888. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org .

title: 'Below Deck' Chef Gets Into Physical Fight With Aggressive Strangers

content: A crew night out on Below Deck took a shocking turn when Chef Moe Vilomar got ready to get into a physical altercation with aggressive strangers. An argument ensued when Moe took off his belt in an apparent plan to escalate the situation. Season 13 has Captain Kerry Titheradge and Fraser Olender joined by alum Rainbeau de Roos. title: Jason Oppenheim Addresses Ex Chrishell Stause’s Split From Partner G Flip
author: Johnni Macke
content: Jason Oppenheim is ready to be a shoulder for ex Chrishell Stause following her shocking split from G Flip . Oppenheim, 49, was quick to support Stause, 45, on Monday, October 26, after she announced her and G Flip’s breakup after three years of marriage and a very public fertility journey. “I’m really sorry to hear this,” he wrote in the comments section of Stause’s emotional video announcement shared via Instagram. “I’m thinking of you and sending you my love.” Stause revealed hours earlier that she and the Australian singer, 33, were “no longer together,” admitting she feels “like a little bit of a failure” after her second broken marriage. (Stause was previously married to Justin Hartley . The pair split in 2019 after two years of marriage, finalizing the divorce in 2021.) Chrishell Stause Announces G Flip Split After 3 Years of Marriage Oppenheim, however, reassured his former Selling Sunset costar that she was not a failure. “You’re both beautiful people and sometimes things just don’t work out, but it certainly doesn’t mean anyone failed,” he wrote. “There’s probably nothing anyone can say to make you feel better right now, it might just take some time to process.” Oppenheim told Stause, “Please know that you’re very loved and I’m always there for you no matter what. ❤️.” Chrishell Stause Explains Why Jason Reconciliation Is 'Never Happening' Following Stause’s divorce from Hartley, 49, she briefly dated Jason while working for him at the Oppenheim Group, which he founded with his twin brother, Brett Oppenheim . The pair sparked romance speculation in July 2021 while on a cast trip to Italy, where Stause was spotted getting cozy with Jason. “Chrishell and I became close friends and it has developed into an amazing relationship,” Jason exclusively told Us that same month. “I care about her deeply and we’re very happy together.” Stause and Jason’s whirlwind romance, however, came to an end before the end of the year. A Look Back at Chrishell Stause and G Flip’s Relationship Before Their Split “While Chrishell and I are no longer together, we remain best friends. We will always love and support one another,” Jason confirmed via Instagram in December 2021. “She was the most amazing girlfriend I’ve ever had, and it was the happiest and most fulfilling relationship of my life. Stause moved on with G Flip in 2022 and the couple got married in May 2023. Throughout their relationship, Stause was open about her infertility struggles as she and G Flip attempted to start a family. Less than one year after Stause told Bustle in November 2025 that she was considering giving IVF “one more chance” after her Selling Sunset exit , she and G Flip called it quits. Chrishell Stause and G Flip. Roy Rochlin/Getty Images for Tribeca Festival “We have agreed to treat this public separation with love and respect for each other. That’s not hard for me because I am in love with this person,” Stause said in her Instagram video on Monday. “I don’t have all the information or the reasons. I’m sure just as always with time you get the lessons you’re meant to get.” G Flip broke their silence on the split that same afternoon, writing in their own social media statement, “After 4+ years Chrishell and I are no longer together. I will always love her, we will always share a special connection and I cherish our memories together deeply.” The “Bed on Fire” singer added, “My head & heart are feeling very heavy right now and I’m not able to talk but I want to thank you all for your support and appreciate you respecting our privacy at this difficult time.”

title: Jon Gosselin's Ex Addresses Kate's 'Concerning' Statements About Collin
author: Mike Vulpo
content: Jon Gosselin ’s ex Colleen Conrad continues to show her support for Collin Gosselin after the release of his shocking memoir . “I’ve recently become aware of several deeply concerning statements Kate has made about Collin, and I believe it is important to address them thoughtfully and factually,” Conrad wrote via Instagram on Monday, October 26. “I am a psychiatric nurse practitioner with more than 35 years of experience in healthcare. My professional background has given me extensive experience with psychiatric diagnoses, symptoms and medications, and this is an area I take very seriously.” Conrad continued, “When Collin came to live with us, I did not observe the symptoms or behaviors I would have expected based on some of the diagnoses he had received, nor did I observe the behaviors that have since been publicly described. In consultation with his treating physician, we gradually discontinued his medications under medical supervision.” Jon’s ex reminded her followers that mental health conditions are “real, complex and deserving of compassion and understanding.” Jon Gosselin Speaks Out on Son Collin After Kate's Mental Illness Comments “However, they should never be used to dismiss another person’s lived experience or deflect legitimate questions about the past,” she continued. “I believe these issues deserve to be addressed with honesty, responsibility and respect for the people involved.” In Collin’s new book, Shadow of Eight: Surviving the Reality of My Childhood , the former Jon & Kate Plus 8 star makes several allegations against his mom, Kate Gosselin , as he recalls his traumatic childhood growing up on reality TV. Collin, 22, detailed his experience as an institutionalized pre-teen after his parents’ 2009 divorce. The Special Forces: World’s Toughest Test contestant claims Kate, 51, sent him to a behavioral health institution in 2016 for what she described as alleged “unpredictable and violent behavior.” Kate’s eldest son spent two years at the institution and a different residential facility before he moved in with Jon, 49. Collin Gosselin Courtesy of Collin Gosselin/Instagram In several TikTok comments, Kate responded to fans with questions or concerns about Collin’s claims. In one response, Kate denied Collin’s allegation that she only visited him once during his time at the mental health institution. “I visited EVERY single time the facility felt he was stable enough for a visit,” she claimed. “Sometimes, a visit was planned but the facility canceled it because he was too unstable and it would have to be rescheduled.” Another user commented, “If he killed animals / threatened with a weapon — it would be in the intake transcripts of the hospital she left him in….it wasn’t.” A follower replied, commenting, “I work in a facility and just because they are violent doesn’t mean they are that way as adults. I wish she would reach out to him and get to know him NOW as an adult.” Kate replied, “And that may be the case for some but you don’t know anything about what his behavior has been like in recent years (I do) because he is choosing not to tell you that part.” Jon Gosselin's Ex Colleen Conrad Reacts to Collin's Memoir Tribute As fans continue to read Shadow of Eight , Collin’s rep Adriane Schwartz is responding to some of Kate’s social media claims. “It is disturbing that Kate continues to make false accusations and publicly attack her own child despite multiple professional psychological evaluations contradicting her claims,” Schwartz said in a statement to Us on Monday. “Let us be absolutely clear: Collin has never used a weapon to harm a family member, nor has he ever harmed or killed an animal in his lifetime. These allegations are categorically false.” The statement continued, “To publicly accuse your innocent child of such heinous acts to protect your reputation is beyond reprehensible. Collin has shown extraordinary courage in telling his story, and he will not be intimidated or silenced by these damaging accusations.”

title: Hilaria Baldwin Claims Husband Alec Would Have More Kids 'If I Let Him'
author: Whitney Vasquez
content: Eight just isn’t enough for Alec Baldwin ! “Alec loves babies. Alec would have more babies if I let them,” Alec’s wife, Hilaria Baldwin , exclusively told Us on Thursday, October 22, while attending the Gala of the Stars event benefiting Dancers Against Cancer. Hilaria, 42, who shares seven biological kids with Alec, 68, said she’s ecstatic that his oldest child, model Ireland Baldwin , is pregnant with her second child. (Alec welcomed Ireland with his first wife, Kim Basinger , in 1995.) “I’m glad that Ireland’s having them because I’m like, ‘Um, this shop is closed,’” Hilaria shared with Us . Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images Hilaria added that she is “so excited” to add another grandchild to the family. “She’s such a good mom, and Holland is like the best, cutest little thing, and so I’m just excited for the next baby,” she said. Ireland, 31, welcomed her daughter , Holland, with boyfriend and musician RAC — real name André Allen Anjos — in May 2023. The couple announced they were expecting their second child in May 2026 by posting a joint Instagram video . Dad of 8 Alec Baldwin Asks Bikini-Clad Hilaria for 'Another Baby' in New Video Hilaria said motherhood is “natural” for Ireland. The pair even share parenting tips. “I feel like I ask just as much advice from her as she asks from me. She just really has such a good compass. Definitely, way more than I did when I was a first-time mom,” Hilaria explained. “Every once in a while, I’m like, ‘Hey, you know what? This nebulizer worked for me’ when Holland is sick or something like that.” Hilaria concluded about her stepdaughter, “Ultimately, she’s just like such a strong, great mom.” Hilaria married Alec in June 2012. The pair share seven children: three daughters, Carmen, 13, María, 5, and Ilaria, 4, and four sons, Rafael, 11, Leonardo, 10, Romeo, 8, and Eduardo, 6. Arturo Holmes/Getty Images In February 2025, Alec opened up about his desire to add another baby to the mix. “Every now and then, when the baby gets older and grows up to be about 2, I look at [Hilaria] and I go, ‘Time to have another,’” the actor confessed to People at the time. His wife, however, wasn’t on board. “They’re so cute,” Hilaria said, “But my body’s really tired.” Later in the interview, the actor joked that he and his wife should be enjoying the lavish life, but are too busy raising seven kids. “I always joke with her and say, ‘You know where I should be right now, don’t you? We should be on Geffen’s yacht, drinking a cappuccino and reading a book, and having dinner with Spielberg or whatever,’” he said, while Hilaria interjected that they were changing diapers instead. The world got an inside look into Alec and Hilaria’s home life when the couple and their children appeared on TLC’s reality show The Baldwins . The series premiered in February 2025.

title: Lawyer Allegedly Stole Over $156K From 2 Clients, Used Some Money to Pay Rent
author: Julia Marnin
content: A Pennsylvania lawyer turned himself in to police after he allegedly stole more than $156,000 from two clients, including an older man whose bank account was drained down to $26. Andrew C. Neville , a now-suspended attorney who owns Neville Law PLLC in Newtown Borough, is charged with financial exploitation of an older adult or care-dependent person, identity theft, theft by unlawful taking, theft by deception, theft by failure to make required disposition of funds, forgery, and receiving stolen property, according to the Bucks County District Attorney’s Office. Neville, 40, of Pennsauken, New Jersey, is accused of using some of the money he stole for gambling and to pay rent on his home and law firm. Neville was arraigned on felony charges the afternoon of Friday, October 23, after he turned himself in, the district attorney’s office said in a news release . His bail was set at $250,000. Former Priest Arrested for Stealing Over $740K From Churches and His Mom Authorities began investigating Neville on October 2, 2025, after a woman reported possible theft from her late mother’s estate, according to prosecutors. Neville had been in charge of providing legal services to the woman’s mother’s estate since October 2024. An investigation revealed Neville stole $113,150 from the deceased client’s estate after he had consolidated the estate’s funds into an account at the First National Bank & Trust Company of Newtown, the district attorney’s office said. He tried to strategically drain the account through 46 alleged unauthorized withdrawals and transfers between January and May of 2025. Investigators also learned Neville had stolen from a second client, a 76-year-old man who “had signed a General Durable Power of Attorney naming Neville as his agent in March 2024,” according to the district attorney’s office. Neville is accused of adding himself to the man’s bank account before making 26 unauthorized transactions of $43,631.78 between July 2024 and May 2025, prosecutors said. The next month, only $26.21 remained in the man’s account, according to prosecutors. Cop and Wife Stole Thousands From 82-Year-Old, Splurged on Cruise, Concerts Neville’s law license was made inactive by the Pennsylvania Supreme Court on June 23, the district attorney’s office said. A few months later, on September 25, he went to the Newtown Borough Police Department and allegedly admitted to stealing from his clients. Neville said the alleged thefts stemmed from when he was experiencing medical problems and substance abuse, as well as “an online gambling addiction where a large portion of the stolen money was transferred,” the district attorney’s office said, citing a criminal complaint. Court records didn’t indicate whether Neville had retained legal counsel as of Monday, October 26. According to the district attorney’s office, Neville hasn’t returned any of the funds stolen from his clients. “Clients put their faith, assets, and future in the hands of their attorneys during some of the most difficult times in their lives,” Bucks County District Attorney Joe Khan said in a statement. “This defendant betrayed the trust placed in him as a legal professional, targeting vulnerable older adults and draining the funds intended for their care and families.”

title: Man Waited Outside Estranged Wife's Home Before Killing Her in Murder-Suicide
author: Katherine Schaffstall
content: A husband killed his wife in an apparent murder-suicide in Florida. The Bradenton Police Department said in a press release that officers responded to a report of a shooting at a Bradenton, Florida, home just before 8 a.m. on Thursday, October 22. Once officers arrived at the scene, they discovered the deceased bodies of Phillip Edmond McClure and Brenda Gail McClure . Authorities quickly determined that Phillip killed Brenda before dying by suicide. According to authorities in the same press release, Phillip, 60, and Brenda, 74, were estranged at the time of their untimely deaths. Husband Fatally Shoots Wife in Apparent Murder-Suicide in California Home After an initial investigation, authorities now believe that Phillip waited for other family members to leave the household before he entered the residence. He then fatally shot Brenda before he died by suicide. Police have not yet revealed if they believe Phillip had a motive in the shootings. Additionally, it’s not currently clear who called the police to report the murder-suicide. Authorities said in the press release that the investigation into the incident remains ongoing. Not much is known about Phillip and Brenda’s relationship, including how long they were together and how long they were estranged prior to their killings. It’s also not known if they shared kids or who else was at the residence on the morning of the shootings. The tragedy has left many neighbors in shock, with Kimberly McDonough telling ABC 7 that she always viewed the couple as friendly and kind. “I know the woman, and I know how incredibly sweet and kind she’s always been to me, and he’s always been really sweet too,” McDonough said of Brenda. Other neighbors confirmed to the outlet that Phillip and Brenda were separated, and one resident claimed there had been concerns about abusive behavior in the weeks before the shooting. However, police did not mention those allegations or reveal if the couple had a history of domestic abuse. Florida Woman Arrested After Confessing to Murder of 76-Year-Old Roommate Over all, all of the residents that spoke to the outlet said they were surprised that the murder-suicide took place. Several members of the community also reacted to the tragedy in the comments section of the police department’s Facebook announcement. “Very sad indeed… May they rest in peace. I hope that family and friends can find comfort in the difficult days ahead. It’s time for people to find their moral compass. If you or someone you know needs help please reach out. There are many free resources available,” one person wrote, and another added, “Prayers for their loved ones. Strength to the first responders who witness this and have to process.” If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org .

title: Sarah Rafferty Teases Emotional 'Walter Boys' Season 4 After Cliffhanger
author: Molly McGuigan
content: Sarah Rafferty is teasing an emotional season of My Life With the Walter Boys ahead — and she had plenty of personal material to draw inspiration from. “Boy, having one of my two daughters leaving this nest this fall definitely made me deeply in touch with my emotions. They were very available to me on screen this fall when we were shooting,” Rafferty, 53, told Us exclusively while discussing her partnership with Eli Lilly and Company earlier this month. Rafferty shares two children with husband Santtu Seppälä : Oona, 19, and 14-year-old Iris. She posted a photo of her eldest daughter heading off to college via Instagram in August. The major transition in Rafferty’s family coincided with her filming Walter Boys season 4, during which her character, Dr. Katherine Walter, has to grapple with the fallout of the previous season’s cliffhanger: her son Cole’s life hanging in the balance after a car crash. 'Life With the Walter Boys' Has 'Intriguing' Return After Deadly Cliffhanger “I love how heart-centered [Katherine] is, and how since she was somebody who was adopted, and she has adopted children as well, that she really wants everybody to feel like they belong, and that’s a beautiful thing to play,” the actress told Us . “There are moments in there that feel like a little love letter to my own kids, moments that are really based on interactions that I’ve had with them. So it really means a lot to me to be playing this at this moment in my life.” While she remained tight-lipped about what fans can expect from season 4 of the hit Netflix drama, Rafferty teased, “I think it’s going to be really exciting. The show just keeps getting more and more beautiful every season.” As for the explosive season 3 finale, she dished, “There’s more where that came from.” Sarah Rafferty in ‘My Life With the Walter Boys’ Netflix / Courtesy Everett Collection Like her character on the show, Rafferty has been intentional when it comes to discussing difficult topics with her children — including her family’s experience with Alzheimer’s disease (AD). “It was a little harder when they were younger and they were noticing the changes in their grandfather. That’s for sure. It was heartbreaking,” Rafferty told Us of her approach to discussing her grandmother and father’s AD diagnoses with her two children. “But then again, it does lead to these positive, optimistic conversations.” Did 'My Life With the Walter Boys' Season 3 Just Confirm [Spoiler]'s Death? The former Suits star is partnering with Eli Lilly and Company to raise awareness around early symptomatic Alzheimer’s disease (ESAD), which can be treated by Kisunla , an amyloid-targeting treatment. “This is a cause near and dear to my heart,” she told Us . “When I first started talking about Alzheimer’s more than a decade ago, I was talking a lot about how there weren’t a lot of options available to my father and grandmother, and now things have changed, and there are options available.” The “Sidebar: A Suits Watch Podcast” cohost added, “I was really excited to partner with Kisunla to encourage people who are having memory or thinking issues, or who are seeing that in a loved one, to have a conversation early with their doctor because the earlier they act, the more options they may have.”

title: Amy Duggar Says Cousin Josh Should 'Rot' in Prison After Appeal Attempts
author: Mike Vulpo
content: Amy Duggar appears to have had enough of cousin Josh Duggar ’s multiple attempts to appeal his child pornography conviction and subsequent prison sentence. “Give it a rest already,” Amy, 40, shared on the Monday, October 26, episode of the “ Fire Chats: The Mindfire Pod ,” hosted by Carrie Berk . “Here’s what I think: Narcissistic people don’t like to be wrong. They don’t like someone questioning their character and making them look like they’re this horrible person, and they don’t think they are. This is all what narcissistic people do. This is textbook, exactly the way a narcissist handles the situation.” Josh, 38, was convicted of receiving and possessing child sexual abuse materia in December 2021. He was later ordered to serve 12 years behind bars. Josh has maintained his innocence despite his conviction, alleging there were “errors in the admission of forensic evidence” at his trial. As a result, he continues to file appeals with his legal team. Josh Duggar Claimed Family Wanted to 'Ambush' Him After Conviction “I find it comical at this stage of his sentence. Just rot in there,” Amy continued of Josh’s many — and unsuccessful — appeals. “Will you just stay in there? What do you think is going to happen when you get out? What does he think? Does he think he’s going to go back to normal life and have a job? The whole thing is a train wreck that I can’t look away from.” When asked if she believes Josh will be released from prison earlier than expected, Amy admits she finds the odds to be unlikely. “There’s no way he needs to be out,” she said. “There’s no way there needs to be any kind of freedom for that man. No shot.” Josh is tentatively scheduled to leave prison in February 2033. His release date, however, has been pushed back on multiple occasions. In June, Josh and his legal team filed another appeal after a judge denied his motion to vacate his conviction. Josh Duggar Allegedly Put in Solitary Confinement for ‘Rule Violations’ While his cousin is less than enthused about his many legal filings, Josh continues to have the support of his wife, Anna Duggar , while he remains incarcerated. The couple share seven children together, with Anna, 38, raising all of the children back home in Arkansas. Recalling the family’s highly-publicized legal drama, Amy appears to have no regrets that she has distanced herself from a majority of her relatives. “It’s a circus. These are not my monkeys. It’s horrible,” she claimed. “I’m related to them. Yes, we’re related by blood, but they don’t know my life. They don’t know me at all.” If you or someone you know is experiencing child abuse, call or text Child Help Hotline at 1-800-422-4453.
